d:
This 10 min daily mobility routine is designed to help you stay flexible, reduce stiffness, and improve how your body moves and feels every day. These simple stretches will open your hips, spine, shoulders, and hamstrings while building strength and control so you can move with more ease.
This is a great routine to do in the morning to wake up your body, after workouts to improve recovery, or anytime you feel tight from sitting or stress. Practicing daily mobility helps prevent injury, improve posture, and maintain long term flexibility as you age.
